title: ST_Geometries
description: Returns the direct members of a geometry as a list, without recursing into nested collections.
kernels:
  - returns: list<geometry>
    args: [geometry]
  - returns: list<geography>
    args: [geography]
---

## Description

Returns `ST_GeometryN(geom, n)` for each `n` from 1 to the number of members: the
parts of a multi-geometry or the members of a geometry collection, one level deep,
so a collection nested inside a collection is returned whole. A geometry that is not
a collection is its own single member, even when it is empty, and an empty
multi-geometry or collection returns an empty list. The members keep the input's
spatial type and CRS, and NULL returns NULL.

Unlike [ST_Dump](st_dump.qmd), which recurses into nested collections down to their
atomic parts, `ST_Geometries` returns only a geometry's direct members. See also
[ST_GeometryN](st_geometryn.qmd).

## Examples

```sql
SELECT ST_Geometries(ST_GeomFromText('MULTIPOINT ((10 40), (40 30), (20 20))'));
```

```sql
SELECT ST_Geometries(ST_GeomFromText('GEOMETRYCOLLECTION (POINT (1 2), GEOMETRYCOLLECTION (POINT (3 4), LINESTRING (0 0, 1 1)))'));
```
